name: Mark Carney
role: Prime Minister of Canada (since 2025); former Governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England
summary: Carney is a centrist, technocratic Liberal who combines support for public health care, climate-risk finance and rights protections with pro-business growth policy, fast-tracked major projects including a new oil pipeline, immigration cuts and a large defence build-up. He champions central bank independence, alliances such as NATO, and diversified trade as a response to US tariffs.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Platform calls health care a right in Canada and pledges to defend the Canada Health Act principles of free, fair, universal and accessible care.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Davos 2026, in his own words: "Since my government took office, we have cut taxes on incomes, on capital gains and business investment" (presented as building strength at home). He also cancelled the capital gains inclusion increase; the platform promises a corporate tax review and tougher evasion enforcement, but he has not called for higher taxes on the wealthy.

unions-good.rationale: Said Budget 2025 would build 'in solidarity with workers, creating good union jobs'.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Pledged less red tape and called past environmental policy 'too much regulation, not enough action', but also backed climate disclosure rules and making big emitters pay.

cut-welfare.rationale: Platform commits to protect transfers to people (pensions, EI, child benefits, GST credit) and to strengthen the safety net; no claim of welfare dependency.

limit-guns.rationale: Platform continues the buyback of assault-style firearms, RCMP classification of new models, automatic licence revocation for violent offenders, while respecting hunting and sport shooting.

empower-police-military.rationale: Doubling defence spending and rearming the Canadian Armed Forces; announced 1,000 new RCMP personnel and tougher bail and sentencing.

abortion-legal.rationale: Platform makes the Sexual and Reproductive Health Fund permanent so there is always funding for abortion care and protects reproductive rights.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Platform pledges to confront systemic barriers facing Indigenous, Black and racialized Canadians and to apply an equity (GBA+) lens to every measure.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Platform pledges to 'protect our culture' and to enshrine CBC/Radio-Canada funding, and stresses Quebec's unique culture.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Campaigned on and enacted lower levels: temporary residents capped below 5% of the population, permanent residents under 1% a year, calling prior levels unsustainable.

free-trade.rationale: Pursues trade deals (ASEAN, Mercosur, internal free trade) and 'open cooperation', but also Buy Canadian procurement and warns of the risks of extreme global integration.

nation-first.rationale: Rejects a 'world of fortresses' as poorer and more fragile and favours coalitions of middle powers, while stressing sovereignty at home.

open-borders.rationale: Record shows tighter visas, border integrity and screening measures; he has not addressed open borders as an aim.

limit-growth.rationale: Sets the goal of the strongest economy in the G7 and presents emissions cuts as compatible with growth ('an economic imperative').

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Long-standing climate-finance advocate (2015 speech, UN envoy) but as PM removed the consumer carbon tax, suspended the emissions cap and agreed an oil pipeline MOU.

expand-nuclear.rationale: First tranche of major projects he announced included nuclear power investment.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Imposed dollar-for-dollar counter-tariffs on the US and favours Buy Canadian, but opposes tariffs as a tool and lowered tariffs on Chinese EVs in a deal.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Major Projects Office, Build Canada Homes as a federal developer and defence industrial policy direct public investment to strategic sectors.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Led two central banks and praised the gains from independent central banking.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Previously rested only on Wikipedia (inviting King Charles III to read the 2025 Throne Speech) with no statement on monarchy as such; no primary source found in this pass.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Platform describes Canada as a mosaic and says 'we are stronger because of our diversity'.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Bill C-5 and the platform promise UNDRIP-aligned consultation and Indigenous equity, but projects proceed over objections of some First Nations.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Budget framing stresses 'results over objectives' and 'investment over prohibition'; platform ties spending to outcomes.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Condemned Hamas's rejection of Israel's right to exist and affirmed steadfast support for the State of Israel and its security, alongside a Palestinian state.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Pledged to balance operating spending but runs large deficits to fund capital investment.

national-self-determination.rationale: Recognition of Palestine framed as aligned with self-determination; backed Greenland's right to determine its future.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Platform pledges equal pay for equal work and a gender-equity lens on all measures.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Backed a new oil pipeline to the BC coast and a carbon-capture project, exempted it from the emissions cap; also frames energy superpower with clean energy.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Platform contrasts the US 'melting pot' with Canada's 'mosaic' and values diverse communities.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Platform speaks of systemic barriers holding women back.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Record of an activist state: universal public health care, federal homebuilding, public broadcaster, industrial strategy.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Platform: Charter guarantees equality under the law and freedom from discrimination for all Canadians.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: States 'we are stronger because of our diversity, not in spite of it'.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Calls Canada's Article 5 commitment 'unwavering' and is building stronger alliances.

minority-language-support.rationale: Platform sets a 12% Francophone immigration target outside Quebec and supports bilingualism.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Platform keeps international humanitarian assistance at no less than $800 million a year and expands development finance.

central-bank-independence.rationale: As governor said the gains from independence were enormous and tied it to price stability and accountability.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Backs a two-state solution as the path to peace and called settlement expansion illegal.

collective-defense.rationale: Called Canada's commitment to NATO Article 5 unwavering.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Described West Bank settlement expansion as illegal and reportedly compared the occupation of Gaza and the West Bank to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Names sovereignty and territorial integrity of states as core values; does not address nationality-based claims directly.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Platform pledges to 'stand up for' the Charter and expand the Court Challenges Program.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Warned a world of fortresses would be poorer and more fragile; pursues trade diversification.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Platform calls the Charter the bedrock of Canadian democracy and promises to defend it.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Platform promises stringent review of foreign purchases of strategic firms and critical infrastructure and to safeguard resources from predatory investors.

single-official-language.rationale: Supports equal status of English and French and protection of French.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Names territorial integrity and the prohibition on force except under the UN Charter as core principles.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Said "yes" when asked whether Canada would arrest Netanyahu in keeping with the ICC warrant (Bloomberg interview, reported by the Times of Israel): treats the international court's order as binding on Canada. No general statement on which takes precedence.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Davos 2026: rejects the "strong tendency for countries to go along to get along, to accommodate, to avoid trouble, to hope that compliance will buy safety. Well, it won't." On negotiating alone with a hegemon: "We accept what's offered. We compete with each other to be the most accommodating. This is not sovereignty. It's the performance of sovereignty while accepting subordination." Uses Havel's ritual sign in the window as the image to reject ("it is time for companies and countries to take their signs down"). Medium: he addresses accommodating today's hegemon, not a formal tribute system.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Platform protects Equalization and other federal transfers.

socialized-care.rationale: Platform makes $10/day child care permanent as a public program.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Platform stresses equality regardless of sexual orientation and funds support for LGBTQI+ people persecuted abroad.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Platform reviews policies with an intersectional (GBA+) lens.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Platform says the Charter protects equality regardless of gender identity and funds 2SLGBTQI+ organizations.

islam-incompatible.rationale: No recorded position on whether Islam is compatible with Western values; praise of religious plurality is a general principle.

social-market-economy.rationale: Combines pro-market growth policy with protected public health care, child care and transfers.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Is rebuilding and rearming the Canadian Armed Forces.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Committed to NATO and allied defence partnerships.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Previously rested on Wikipedia only. The 2016 Roscoe Lecture it refers to says "Such high income inequalities are dwarfed by staggering wealth inequalities" and that "public support for open markets is under threat", but does not say concentrated wealth endangers a free society. Not settled as worded.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Announced 1,000 new RCMP personnel and tougher bail and sentencing.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Keeps and improves output-based carbon pricing for large emitters ('big polluters pay') while scrapping the consumer carbon tax.

future-generations.rationale: Described climate costs imposed on future generations and says policy must consider children and grandchildren.

public-service-media.rationale: Platform legislates statutory funding for CBC/Radio-Canada to insulate it from government whims and strengthens its mandate.

farm-price-support.rationale: Platform keeps supply management off the table in trade talks and protects supply-managed sectors.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Asked in a Bloomberg interview (Oct 2025) whether Canada would arrest Netanyahu under the ICC warrant, he answered "yes" (as reported by the Times of Israel). A one-word answer known from a news report, so low.

close-ties-china.rationale: Concluded a strategic partnership with China in January 2026 as part of diversifying away from US dependence, while warning of an assertive China.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Cut GST for first-time homebuyers and suspended the federal fuel excise tax.

national-resource-control.rationale: Platform pledges to safeguard Canadian resources from predatory investors.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Platform stresses systemic barriers still facing racialized and Indigenous communities.

multipolar-world.rationale: Urges middle powers to combine in coalitions to avoid subordination to a hegemon.

notes: Views shifted on carbon pricing: he backed the consumer carbon tax in 2019 and said in 2024 it had 'served a purpose up until now'; as PM he cancelled it (March 2025) while keeping industrial pricing. Most recent position used. Several answers rest on the Liberal platform he led. Books (Value(s)) and Reith lectures were not accessible as full text. Opus pass 2026-10-31: read the full WEF transcript of the 2026 Davos address (s12) against every unanswered statement; it settles deference-to-leading-power and strengthens tax-the-wealthy; its other themes (NATO, fortresses, sovereignty, Greenland) were already answered from the pm.gc.ca copy (s3). force-without-un left null: he commits to force only 'consistent with the UN Charter', which allows self-defence without Security Council approval. Four Wikipedia-only answers re-sourced (ICC answers, s14) or nulled (monarchy; wealth concentration after reading the 2016 lecture, s13).
